Was that actually throwing before ?

I would prefer a throw there, as this trying to publish feedback after the goal was closed is a clear logic programming error.

@jmachowinski no it was never implemented in that way... even though doc section defines that behavior.


i was going to that way, but my though is that would be kinda surprising...

Judging from our own stack, warnings get ignored, as they are in the general console spam.

Exceptions get fixed... I can't think of a scenario were sending feedback after sending the goal result is correct. Especially as the doc already mentioned it, the exception seems more as the way to go...
i will go ahead to merge this, if necessary, we can enforce the exception after some period that prints the warning.
